title: Show Me Under
can_do: 听不懂一个指令时直接说明，并请求一次示范。
trigger: Rabbit Teacher gives a short activity direction containing a location word the child does not yet understand.
stretch_response: I don't understand. Can you show me?
repair_response: Can you show me what under means?
setting: A simple tabletop activity at school.

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: Put one blue counter under the cup.

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: Would you like me to show you once?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Yes, please. Can you show me what under means?

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: I put mine here, under the cup.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Now I understand. I put mine under the cup.

replay_cards.title: Show me beside
replay_cards.change: Teacher says to place a card beside the box
replay_cards.challenge: Say it is unclear, watch one example, then place the child's card beside the box

replay_cards.title: Show me fold
replay_cards.change: Dad says to fold it in half
replay_cards.challenge: Ask for a demonstration, watch one fold, then fold the second napkin

parent_support: Respond to not understanding as useful information, not misbehavior.
Demonstrate once with your own object, then let the child complete the parallel action.
